name: walletfreak-spending
description: Analyze local PDF and CSV statement references and show sourced spending metrics in WalletFreak.

interface.longDescription: Drop PDF/CSV statements into the WalletFreak workspace, ask your agent to analyze local references, and explore sourced metrics. Includes bank guides and an optional CSV spreadsheet. Requires WalletFreak.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my uploaded statement references and show key metrics in my Spending dashboard.
Help me categorize downloaded bank activity locally.
